brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three hex-acc-keyhole accessories on rear face slot 2 of cells -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 (refs accessory:0#-1,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2) for lift-and-drop wall mounting
Three hex-acc-hook hook plates on front face slot 5 of same three cells (refs accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5); each plate carries two hooks side-by-side = 6 hooks total

finish.summary: 3-cell linear tool rack locked with jointBolts, keyhole hangers on rear (slot 2) for wall mounting and hook plates on front (slot 5) for hand tools; meshClash clear, no errors.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build completed as wall-mounted tool rack.

**Requirements:**
- Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers – **met**: hex-acc-keyhole placed on rear face (slot 2) of all three cells (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) – refs accessory:0#-1,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2
- Hooks for small hand tools – **met**: hex-acc-hook hook plates placed on front face (slot 5) of all three cells – refs accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5 – each plate provides two hooks (total 6 hooks)

Linear 3-cell base (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) locked with jointBolts, keyholes rear-facing for wall screws, hooks forward-facing for tool hanging. Mesh clash clear, no rule errors.
